versions.description: Clans: players form groups with a name and tag. Create a clan (optional currency cost), invite online players, join by invite, leave, and let leaders/officers kick members. Clan chat sends a private message to every online member. Optional shared clan bank (deposit; leader withdraws). Leaderboard ranks clans by total member playtime. All data lives in Takaro variables. Works on every game that supports private messages.

permissions.description: Allows a player to join, leave, chat in and view clans. Give this to the Player role.
Allows a player to create a clan. Give this to Player (or only VIP) together with CLANS_USE.
Allows an admin to disband any clan with clan disband <name>.
